% A guard, for files of the document named like a .4ht file: a copy of a
% plain TeX macro file that TeX Live does not ship as .tex, Paul Taylor's
% diagrams.tex, in the document's folder, read with \input. diagrams.ltx
% stands in for the copy; its name ends in .ltx, so that it is not a
% fixture. As tex4ht's diagrams.4ht sets it, the diagram is a picture.
\documentclass{article}
\IfFileExists{./diagrams.ltx}{}{\errmessage{No copy of diagrams.tex beside the document}}
\input{diagrams.ltx}
\begin{document}
A diagram: \diagram{A\to B}
\end{document}
